lines.en: label day271:
scene reunion1
Ami and I leave[school] together, the same way we’ve done countless times before.
lines.zh: Ami 和我一起离开[school]，就像我们以前做过无数次的那样。

lines.en: We pass the same old stores, the same old street food vendors who can never even be bothered to look at us (Which is horrible marketing, if you ask me)-
lines.zh: 我们路过那些一成不变的店铺、那些一成不变的街边小吃摊，摊主甚至连看都懒得看我们一眼（要我说，这营销做得真烂）——

lines.en: And talk about the same old things as we traverse the same old snow piles I’m so quickly growing accustomed to.
lines.zh: 一边翻过那些我已经迅速习惯了的、一成不变的雪堆，一边聊着一成不变的话题。

lines.en: I think I prefer winter in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我想我更喜欢 Kumon-mi 的冬天。

lines.en: As you may have heard before, I’ve never been a fan of the heat. And yes, it is fucking cold here in the winter, but not cold enough to kill you.
lines.zh: 正如你可能听说过的，我从来都不喜欢热。没错，这里的冬天他妈的冷，但还没冷到能冻死你。

lines.en: And the fact that I’m meeting so many new people makes my newfound affinity for this season all the more enjoyable.
lines.zh: 再加上我认识了这么多新的人，这让我对这季节新生的好感变得更加愉快。

lines.en: I smile to myself in the darkest section of my mind, but not anywhere on the exterior.
lines.zh: 我在脑海最阴暗的角落里对自己笑了笑，外表上却毫无流露。

lines.en: I’m excited to watch everyone grow.
lines.zh: 我很期待看着每一个人成长。

lines.en: To watch them shrink.
lines.zh: 看着她们萎缩。

lines.en: To watch them bend.
lines.zh: 看着她们屈服。

lines.en: And break.
lines.zh: 然后折断。

lines.en: And bleed.
lines.zh: 然后流血。

lines.en: That last one was a reference to defloration.
lines.zh: 最后那个是在指破处。

lines.en: : So...what do you think of Maya’s new uniform, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么……你觉得 Maya 的新制服怎么样，Sensei？

lines.en: : This is a trick question. You just want me to say that yours is cuter.
lines.zh: : 这是个陷阱题。你就是想让我说你的更可爱。

lines.en: : Me? Noooo. Of course not.
lines.zh: : 我？才不——是。当然不是。

lines.en: : But now that you’ve said it, you can’t take it back.
lines.zh: : 不过你既然已经说了，就不能收回了。

lines.en: : Thank you for calling me the prettiest girl in all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你说我是全 Kumon-mi 最漂亮的女孩。

lines.en: : It’s really admirable how you’re always able to hear exactly what you want to hear.
lines.zh: : 你总能精确地听到自己想听的话，这一点真挺让人佩服的。

lines.en: : Not always.
lines.zh: : 也不总是。

lines.en: : Like, when that new girl said all that stuff about being in love with you the other day, I almost jumped out of my chair to strangle her to death.
lines.zh: : 比如说，前几天那个新来的女生说了一大堆爱你的话，我当时差点从椅子上跳起来把她勒死。

lines.en: : Your best friend was the one who jumped. You just raised your hand and asked who she was.
lines.zh: : 跳起来的是你最好的朋友。你只是举了下手，问她是谁。

lines.en: scene reunion2
: Oh! You still haven’t explained that to me!
lines.zh: : 哦！这件事你还没跟我解释过呢！

lines.en: : How do you know her? And how does she know me?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么认识她的？她又是怎么认识我的？！

lines.en: : Since when are there other girls in your life?!
lines.zh: : 你身边什么时候开始有别女生了？！

lines.en: : There are more girls in my life than I can count now.
lines.zh: : 现在我人生里的女生多得数不过来了。

lines.en: : But only one of them has gotten in front of the class and proclaimed her love for you.
lines.zh: : 但只有一个站到全班面前宣告过她爱你。

lines.en: : Two. You're not counting Ayane.
lines.zh: : 两个。你没算上 Ayane。

lines.en: : Literally no one counts Ayane. She says it so often that we just consider it one of her character traits.
lines.zh: : 真的没人会把 Ayane 算进去。她说得太频繁了，我们都把这当成她的性格特征之一了。

lines.en: : That is...fair.
lines.zh: : 这……倒也公道。

lines.en: scene reunion3
: So...who is she? And what was she talking about when she said all that stuff?
lines.zh: : 那么……她是谁？她说那堆话到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : She told me yesterday that she used to be my neighbor...and that I’d spend time hanging out at her house pretty often.
lines.zh: : 她昨天告诉我，她以前是我的邻居……而且我经常去她家玩。

lines.en: : But she’s my age. Why would you be with a girl that [young]when-
lines.zh: : 可她跟我同岁。你那时候怎么会跟一个那么[young]的女孩——

lines.en: scene reunion4
: Actually, no. I can see it.
lines.zh: : 其实，不。我能想象得出来。

lines.en: : Huh.
: I guess you’ve just always been that way...
lines.zh: : 我想你一直都是那个样子吧……

lines.en: : I was visiting her older sister...
lines.zh: : 我是去看她姐姐的……

lines.en: : It’s before you and I lived together.
lines.zh: : 那是在你和我住在一起之前的事。

lines.en: scene reunion5
: How does she know me then? I don’t remember anyone like that and we didn't live together until you moved.
lines.zh: : 那她怎么会认识我？我完全不记得有这样的人，而且我们直到你搬过来才住在一起。

lines.en: : Not sure. You can ask her.
lines.zh: : 不确定。你可以去问她。

lines.en: : Apparently, I tutored her for a while as well. Maybe you met her back then?
lines.zh: : 据说我也给她做过一段时间的家教。也许你是那时候认识她的？

lines.en: : If she was still around at that time, I’m surprised she doesn’t know Ayane as well.
lines.zh: : 如果她那时候还在附近，我很意外她居然也不认识 Ayane。

lines.en: : Maybe she met you when you visited my...old house or something?
lines.zh: : 也许是你来我……老房子玩的时候见过她？

lines.en: Did the old Sensei even live in a house?
lines.zh: 旧 Sensei 到底住的是房子吗？

lines.en: Was it an apartment?
lines.zh: 还是公寓？

lines.en: Maybe Noriko knows.
lines.zh: 也许 Noriko 知道。

lines.en: scene reunion6
: Huh...
: Now that I think about it...I might vaguely remember a play date with some girl when I came over to visit once.
lines.zh: : 现在想想……我好像隐约记得有一次过来玩的时候，跟某个女孩有过一次玩耍约会。

lines.en: : I think her hair was a different color, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我记得她头发是别的颜色。

lines.en: : Oh. Well it’s physically impossible for a girl to change her hair color, so you’re probably thinking of someone else.
lines.zh: : 哦。女生在生理上是不可能改变头发颜色的，所以你想的八成是别人。

lines.en: scene reunion7
: Hey! I know sarcasm when I hear it, Mister!
lines.zh: : 喂！我听得出来什么是讽刺，先生！

lines.en: : Guess who’s cutting the onions for dinner tonight as punishment?
lines.zh: : 猜猜今晚谁要作为惩罚来切洋葱？

lines.en: : If you’re suggesting making me do something that boring, I’ll just have Ayane come over and step in.
lines.zh: : 如果你打算让我做那么无聊的事，我就把 Ayane 叫过来顶替。

lines.en: : No! Stop inviting Ayane to the house or she’s going to think you two are in love!
lines.zh: : 不要！别再叫 Ayane 来家里了，不然她会以为你们俩恋爱了！

lines.en: : Stop making me cut onions.
lines.zh: : 那就别让我切洋葱。

lines.en: scene reunion8
: I’ll make you do whatever I want to make you do. You’re a slave to my cooking and...feminine wiles now.
lines.zh: : 我想让你做什么，你就得做什么。你现在已经是我厨艺的奴隶，还有……我女人味的奴隶了。

lines.en: : I have no problem reverting to garlic bread seven days a week if you’re going to call me a slave to anything.
lines.zh: : 如果你非要把我说成什么奴隶的话，我完全不介意回到一周七天都吃蒜香面包的日子。

lines.en: : You’re the one who made me this way, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是你把我变成这样的，Sensei。

lines.en: : If it wasn’t for you getting so caught up in your own thoughts back when I was little, Mega Ami never would have happened.
lines.zh: : 要不是我小时候你总陷在自己的思绪里，就不会有什么 Mega Ami 了。

lines.en: : Mega Ami?...
lines.zh: : Mega Ami？……

lines.en: scene reunion9
: Mega Ami. The current version of Ami that you know and love.
lines.zh: : Mega Ami。就是你所熟知并喜爱的这个当下的 Ami。

lines.en: : The one that cooks and cleans for you. And wakes you up in the morning. And hasn’t yet but would absolutely wash your back in the bath if you asked her to.
lines.zh: : 那个给你做饭、给你打扫、早上叫你起床的 Ami。还有，虽然还没做过，但只要你开口，她绝对会帮你在浴缸里搓背。

lines.en: : Oh, speaking of cooking and all that stuff, is there anything specific you want for dinner?
lines.zh: : 哦，说到做饭什么的，晚饭有什么特别想吃的吗？

lines.en: : The onion thing was a joke. We don’t even have onions. But we can buy some if you want an...onion-based thingy.
lines.zh: : 洋葱那事是开玩笑的。我们家连洋葱都没有。不过你要是想吃个……洋葱做的东西，我们可以去买。

lines.en: : Just tell me what you want and I’ll make it happen, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 你只要说想要什么，我就能给你变出来，Sensei~

lines.en: scene reunion10
: How about something with chickpeas? I’ve been trying to go vegetarian lately and those things are frickin’ addictive.
lines.zh: : 来点鹰嘴豆做的怎么样？我最近在试着吃素，那玩意儿简直他妈的上瘾。

lines.en: : Chickpeas? Hmm...I haven’t tried making anything with those before. But I think one of the dishes Ayane likes to make has-
lines.zh: : 鹰嘴豆？嗯……我没试过用那个做过菜。不过我记得 Ayane 喜欢做的一道菜里有——

lines.en: : Has what?
lines.zh: : 里有什么？

lines.en: scene reunion11
: Pink girl!
lines.zh: : 粉毛女！

lines.en: : Unhand my [uncle]!
lines.zh: : 放开我的[uncle]！

lines.en: : What an entirely uncreative nickname.
lines.zh: : 这个外号真是毫无创意。

lines.en: : Why do I have to make dinner for you now?! And where did you even come from?!
lines.zh: : 为什么我现在还得给你做晚饭啊？！还有你到底是从哪儿冒出来的？！

lines.en: : This is supposed to be my time with Sensei!
lines.zh: : 这本该是我和 Sensei 独处的时间！

lines.en: scene reunion12
: But you get to see him every day~
lines.zh: : 可你每天都见得到他呀~

lines.en: : This makes absolutely no difference to me.
lines.zh: : 这对我来说完全没有区别。

lines.en: : You would know this if you didn’t randomly show up and decide to start getting your...pink all over him.
lines.zh: : 你要不是突然冒出来，还决定把你那身……粉色蹭得他满身都是，你就明白了。

lines.en: : Amiiiiiiiiiii~
lines.zh: : Amiiiiiiiiiii~

lines.en: : Don’t say my name with so many I’s, you harlot.
lines.zh: : 别把我的名字拖那么长的音，你这个骚货。

lines.en: : Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami~
lines.zh: : Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami~

lines.en: scene reunion13
: Don’t say my name so many times in general!
lines.zh: : 总之别把我的名字念那么多遍！

lines.en: : Go get your own chickpeas!
lines.zh: : 想吃鹰嘴豆自己去买！

lines.en: : Amiiiiiiii <3
lines.zh: : Amiiiiiiii <3

lines.en: : You really like saying that, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真的很喜欢这么叫，是吧？

lines.en: : Can I borrow your [uncle] pleeeeeease?~
lines.zh: : 能把你的[uncle]借给我吗，求——求你了~？

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 不行！

lines.en: : Pleeeeeeeeeease?~
: NO!
: C’mon~ I’ll bring him back good as new. I promise.
lines.zh: : 拜托啦~ 我会把他完好无损地还回来的。我保证。

lines.en: : Just for a little while. I need to show him something.
lines.zh: : 就一会儿。我要带他去看个东西。

lines.en: scene reunion14
: How do I know you won’t try to steal him from me forever?
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道你不会把他从我身边永远抢走？

lines.en: : Because in my master plan, we all live happily ever after together.
lines.zh: : 因为在我的宏大计划里，我们大家要一起幸福地生活下去。

lines.en: : And you and I have matching aprons and take turns cooking dinner and doing each other’s hair.
lines.zh: : 而且你和我穿着同款围裙，轮流做晚饭，互相给对方梳头发。

lines.en: : That...does sound pretty nice.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来确实挺不错的。

lines.en: : But I don’t like the idea of someone el-
lines.zh: : 但我不喜欢有别的人——

lines.en: : I don't like the idea of someone in general being in love with him.
lines.zh: : 总之我不喜欢有人爱上他。

lines.en: : Good save, Ami.
lines.zh: : 圆得不错，Ami。

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : Sensei, promise her we won’t make out or anything so you can come with me.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你跟她保证我们不会接吻什么的，这样你就能跟我走了。

lines.en: : Ami, I promise not to make out with Noriko.
lines.zh: : Ami，我保证不会和 Noriko 接吻。

lines.en: : I’m gonna need a little more than that.
lines.zh: : 光这样还不够。

lines.en: : How much more do you need?
lines.zh: : 你还要多少？

lines.en: : I can give you my shoe as collateral and just hop around instead if you want.
lines.zh: : 要不我把鞋押给你，我就单脚跳着走也行。

lines.en: : I’ve got pretty good balance, so I wouldn’t even mind.
lines.zh: : 我平衡感挺好的，所以完全不介意。

lines.en: scene reunion15
: She’s nicer than I expected her to be after Maya’s reaction the other day.
lines.zh: : 考虑到那天 Maya 的反应，她比我想象中要随和。

lines.en: : I think Maya’s going through some stuff right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Maya 现在正在经历一些事。

lines.en: : Mmm...no? I think she had hers last week.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不对吧？我觉得她上周刚来过。

lines.en: : Oh. You didn’t mean that.
lines.zh: : 哦。你说的不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Menstrual cycles aside, I’m gonna pull on your [uncle]’s arm and run away with him now. Okay?
lines.zh: : 先把月经的话题放一边，我现在要拉着你的[uncle]的手臂跟他私奔了。好吗？

lines.en: : I’ll have him back for dinner.
lines.zh: : 晚饭前我会把他还回来。

lines.en: : Also, I love your sweater. Do you want to trade clothes sometime?
lines.zh: : 另外，我好喜欢你这件毛衣。要不要哪天换着穿？

lines.en: : Not...particularly.
lines.zh: : 不……太想。

lines.en: : I guess I’ll be back later?
lines.zh: : 那我晚点回来？

lines.en: : Yeah, fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧。

lines.en: : But don’t be gone too long. I wanted to eat with you tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过别去太久。我今晚想和你一起吃饭。

lines.en: scene reunion16
: Yay! Thanks, Ami!
lines.zh: : 耶！谢谢你，Ami！

lines.en: : Let’s catch up soon! Just make sure you don’t also have plans with Maya that day cause she kind of doesn’t like me very much.
lines.zh: : 我们改天再好好聊聊！不过那天你最好别同时也约了 Maya，因为她好像不太喜欢我。

lines.en: : Yeah...she really doesn’t...
lines.zh: : 是啊……她是真的很不喜欢……

lines.en: scene black
Noriko tugs on my arm and quickly pulls me down the street and around the corner.
lines.zh: Noriko 拽着我的手臂，飞快地拉着我沿街走过拐角。

lines.en: The bottoms of my shoes are worn out from walking so much, so I almost slip on the snow a few times in the process.
lines.zh: 我鞋底因为走太多路已经磨平了，一路上好几次差点在雪地上滑倒。

lines.en: This, in turn, causes Noriko to slip as well.
lines.zh: 而这又反过来让 Noriko 也跟着打滑。

lines.en: And even though neither one of us ever truly falls, there is more than enough impartial balance to last the two of us a lifetime.
lines.zh: 虽然我们俩谁都没真正摔倒，但那种不偏不倚的平衡感，足够我们俩用上一辈子了。

lines.en: scene reunion17
: Hmm hmm hmm~ Hmm hmm hmm hmmm~
lines.zh: : 哼哼哼~ 哼哼哼哼~

lines.en: : What are you singing?
lines.zh: : 你在唱什么？

lines.en: : Actually, better question- where are you taking me?
lines.zh: : 其实，更好的问题是——你要带我去哪儿？

lines.en: scene reunion18
: Conveniently enough, the answer to both of those is pretty much the same.
lines.zh: : 巧得很，这两个问题的答案基本是一样的。

lines.en: : It’s one of my sister’s songs. That’s who we’re going to meet right now.
lines.zh: : 这是我姐姐的歌。我们现在要去见的也是她。

lines.en: : The girl I used to hang out with is a musician?
lines.zh: : 我以前经常一起玩的那个女孩是个音乐人？

lines.en: scene reunion19
: Wait, you didn’t know?
lines.zh: : 等等，你不知道吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even know her name.
lines.zh: : 我连她名字都不知道。

lines.en: : And the fact that you know my last name is Nakayama and that I also have bright pink hair isn’t...ringing any bells?
lines.zh: : 你知道我姓 Nakayama，也知道我有一头亮粉色的头发，这些都没让你想起什么吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Really? Niki Nakayama?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？Niki Nakayama？

lines.en: : Nothing?
lines.zh: : 一点印象都没有？

lines.en: : You...you do own a TV, right?
lines.zh: : 你……你总该有台电视吧？

lines.en: : I do. I don’t think I’ve heard of a Niki Nakayama, though.
lines.zh: : 有。不过我不记得听说过什么 Niki Nakayama。

lines.en: scene reunion20
: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 糟了。

lines.en: : Uh-oh what?
lines.zh: : 糟了什么？

lines.en: : She is not going to like that very much.
lines.zh: : 她听了肯定很不高兴。

lines.en: : This whole time, she’s been like “Ha! I hope he sees how big I’ve gotten and comes crawling back so I can laugh in his face!” and stuff.
lines.zh: : 这段时间她一直在说「哈！希望他看到我现在有多红，然后爬回来求我，我就能当面嘲笑他！」之类的话。

lines.en: : Why would you willingly take me to meet a person who thinks of me that way?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还心甘情愿地带我去见一个这么想我的人？

lines.en: scene reunion21
: Well...
: Because it wouldn't be fair if only I get to know where you are and she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 因为如果只有我知道你在哪儿而她不知道，那对她不公平。

lines.en: : She took you leaving harder than anybody.
lines.zh: : 你离开这件事，她比任何人都难受。

lines.en: : But I guess five years with somebody will do that to you.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，和一个人相处五年，大概就会变成那样吧。

lines.en: Did she just say five years?
lines.zh: 她刚才是说五年吗？

lines.en: I had a feeling there was a possible romance with this sister of hers if I spent so much time at her house back then, but-
lines.zh: 我本来就有预感，既然我那会儿老待在她家，和她这个姐姐之间可能有过一段恋情，不过——

lines.en: Five years?
lines.zh: 五年？

lines.en: That’s longer than some people live.
lines.zh: 那比有些人活的时间还长。

lines.en: Granted, SIDS is a thing that exists, so pretty much any relationship is longer than some people live.
lines.zh: 当然，婴儿猝死综合征这种东西是存在的，所以基本上任何一段恋情都比有些人活的时间长。

lines.en: Five years, though...
lines.zh: 可五年啊……

lines.en: scene black
I wonder if she’ll be happy to see me.
lines.zh: 我不知道她见到我会不会高兴。

lines.en: Noriko pulls open the door to some sort of studio and waves at a few of the...technicians (?) as we walk by.
lines.zh: Noriko 拉开某间摄影棚的门，我们走过时她朝几个……技术人员（？）挥了挥手。

lines.en: I don’t know what title the staff in places like these go by.
lines.zh: 我不知道这种地方的工作人员该怎么称呼。

lines.en: We make our way through a tightly packed studio and wind up behind a large camera.
lines.zh: 我们穿过一间挤得满满当当的摄影棚，最后停在一台大摄像机后面。

lines.en: It looks like they’re shooting some sort of commercial.
lines.zh: 看起来他们在拍某种广告。

lines.en: And the subject of said commercial is-
lines.zh: 而这个广告的主角是——

lines.en: scene reunion22
: And that’s why when I’m feeling thirsty, I grab a Coca-Cola.
lines.zh: : 所以，当我口渴的时候，我就会拿一罐可口可乐。

lines.en: : It’s the only drink that can make a girl like me feel as bright as-
lines.zh: : 它是唯一一种能让像我这样的女孩感觉如此闪亮的饮料，就像——

lines.en: scene reunion23
: Nee-chan! Look who I brought with me!
lines.zh: : 姐姐！看我把谁带来了！

lines.en: : Cut!
: Noriko...how many times do I need to ask you to stop yelling things while we’re shooting?
lines.zh: : Noriko……我要说多少次你才肯别在拍摄的时候大喊大叫？

lines.en: : Sorry, chief! This time it’s really important, though!
lines.zh: : 对不起，老大！不过这次真的很要紧！

lines.en: : Noriko...my dear, dear sister...
lines.zh: : Noriko……我亲爱的、亲爱的妹妹……

lines.en: : If you interrupt me while I am working one more time, I-
lines.zh: : 你要是再在我工作的时候打断我一次，我就——

lines.en: scene reunion24
There are likely a million things running through my apparent ex-girlfriend’s mind right now.
lines.zh: 我这位名义上的前女友脑子里此刻大概有一百万个念头在翻涌。

lines.en: It must be quite a heartwarming experience to find that the boy you’ve spent so many years thinking about is suddenly right in front of-
lines.zh: 发现那个你惦记了这么多年的男人突然就站在自己面前，一定是一段相当温暖的经历吧——

lines.en: scene reunion25
: WHAT THE FUCK ARE YOU DOING HERE?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : WHERE HAVE YOU BEEN?!
lines.zh: : 你这些年跑哪儿去了？！

lines.en: : AND WHY ARE YOU SHOWING UP IN THE MIDDLE OF A SHOOT?!
lines.zh: : 还有你为什么偏偏在拍摄中途冒出来？！

lines.en: : AND WHY IS MY LITTLE SISTER TENDERLY RUBBING YOUR BACK?!
lines.zh: : 还有我妹妹为什么在温柔地摸你的背？！

lines.en: : Nee-chan! I hereby declare war!
lines.zh: : 姐姐！我在此正式宣战！

lines.en: : I am now old enough to understand love and will be dedicating myself fully to your ex-boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 我已经到了懂爱的年纪，我要全心全意献身于你的前男友。

lines.en: scene reunion26
: Excuse me?...
lines.zh: : 你说什么？……

lines.en: : Oh, God damnit! Can we get somebody to clean that up?
lines.zh: : 哦，该死！谁能来收拾一下？

lines.en: scene reunion27
: You came all this way to tell me that? Is this some sort of joke?
lines.zh: : 你大老远跑来就为了跟我说这个？这是在开玩笑吗？

lines.en: : Wow, they cleaned up that soda really quickly.
lines.zh: : 哇，那杯汽水清理得真快。

lines.en: : The custodial staff here is crazy good. And underpaid, in my opinion.
lines.zh: : 这里的保洁人员厉害得离谱。而且我觉得他们工资还偏低。

lines.en: : STOP TALKING ABOUT THE FUCKING SODA AND PAY ATTENTION TO ME!
lines.zh: : 别他妈聊那杯汽水了，给我注意听我说话！

lines.en: : Niki, we have executives from Coca-Cola here and-
lines.zh: : Niki，可口可乐的高管在这儿——

lines.en: : FUCK THE COCA-COLA!
lines.zh: : 去他妈的可口可乐！

lines.en: : You know what? Everybody take five. Or ten, actually!
lines.zh: : 这样吧，大家休息五分钟。不，十分钟吧！

lines.en: : Just...go down the street and grab a drink or something.
lines.zh: : 就……去街上买杯喝的什么的。

lines.en: scene reunion28
: Make sure you pick up Coca-Cola! It’s fucking...good or whatever!
lines.zh: : 记得买可口可乐！它他妈的……挺好的什么的！

lines.en: : Her temper hasn’t changed much, but it’s not like you remember how it used to be in the first place.
lines.zh: : 她的脾气没怎么变，不过反正你本来也不记得以前是什么样。

lines.en: scene reunion29
Niki rushes off the set and immediately storms over to Noriko and me.
lines.zh: Niki 快步冲下布景台，立刻气势汹汹地朝 Noriko 和我走来。

lines.en: Instead of providing any sort of assistance whatsoever, though, Noriko decides to just start giggling to herself as her sister pierces my soul with her gaze.
lines.zh: 不过 Noriko 完全没打算提供任何帮助，而是自己咯咯笑了起来，任由她姐姐用目光把我的灵魂刺穿。

lines.en: : You better have a good fucking explanation for this.
lines.zh: : 你最好给我一个他妈的像样的解释。

lines.en: : How long has Noriko known about you being back? How long has she been keeping this a secret from me?
lines.zh: : Noriko 知道你回来多久了？她瞒了我多久？

lines.en: : And why didn’t you ever try calling? I’m famous now! I’m on Google!
lines.zh: : 还有你为什么从来没试着打个电话？我现在出名了！我在谷歌上都搜得到！

lines.en: : Pictures of me come up when you type my name in! It's a big deal!
lines.zh: : 你把我的名字打进去，我的照片就出来了！这可是件大事！

lines.en: scene reunion30
: Bet you’re regretting leaving me in the dust now, huh?
lines.zh: : 现在后悔当年把我甩在身后了吧？

lines.en: : I bet you were just intimidated to reach out since I’ve gotten so big.
lines.zh: : 我猜你是因为我现在这么红了，不敢联系我吧。

lines.en: : Nee-chan, Sensei’s actually never even heard your music.
lines.zh: : 姐姐，Sensei 其实根本没听过你的歌。

lines.en: scene reunion31
: Huh?
: I’m going to defer to my secretary on this.
lines.zh: : 这件事我交给我的秘书来解释。

lines.en: : Sensei has amnesia. He doesn’t even remember me.
lines.zh: : Sensei 失忆了。他连我都不记得了。

lines.en: : But that’s okay because we’re going to start from scratch and rebuild our relationship.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系，因为我们要从零开始，把我们的关系重新建起来。

lines.en: : Like I’m going to buy that fucking sob story.
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不会信这套哭哭啼啼的鬼话。

lines.en: : You have ears, right? Listen real closely and you might hear my fucking song playing right now.
lines.zh: : 你有耳朵吧？给我仔细听好了，说不定你正在听到我那首该死的歌。

lines.en: scene reunion32
I do as instructed and listen closely.
lines.zh: 我照她说的，仔细听了听。

lines.en: The song on the radio or speakers or...whatever it’s playing on actually sounds kind of familiar.
lines.zh: 收音机里、或者音箱里、或者……不管是什么在放的这首歌，听起来确实有点耳熟。

lines.en: I can’t remember where I’ve heard it before, but-
lines.zh: 我不记得以前在哪儿听过，不过——

lines.en: : You wrote this?
lines.zh: : 这是你写的？

lines.en: : Uh-huh.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : Well, a team of producers wrote it. But I perform it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是一群制作人写的。不过是我唱的。

lines.en: : I still do all the heavy lifting, though. Do you have any idea how fucking cutthroat this industry can be? It’s insane.
lines.zh: : 不过最累的活还是我来干。你知道这行有多他妈的血腥吗？简直疯了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure my [niece] listens to this.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定我[niece]有在听这首歌。

lines.en: scene reunion33
: Is she doing okay?
lines.zh: : 她还过得好吗？

lines.en: : I haven’t heard anything since the accident and...
lines.zh: : 那场事故之后我就再没听到过任何消息，然后……

lines.en: : She’s super cute now. I saw her on the way over here.
lines.zh: : 她现在超级可爱。我来这儿的路上见到她了。

lines.en: scene reunion34
: Good!
lines.zh: : 那就好！

lines.en: : Then I have nothing to worry about and can go back to being mad!
lines.zh: : 那我就没什么好担心的了，可以继续生气了！

lines.en: : I can’t believe you would just show up here after all these years without so much as an apology!
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信，过了这么多年你就这么冒出来，连句道歉都没有！

lines.en: Was this really the original Sensei’s type?
lines.zh: 这真的是原来那个 Sensei 喜欢的类型吗？

lines.en: She seems a little...overbearing.
lines.zh: 她看起来有点……强势过头。

lines.en: Granted, the love of her life just up and left without ever letting her know where he was going, so...
lines.zh: 当然了，她这辈子最爱的人一声不吭就走了，连去了哪儿都没告诉她，所以……

lines.en: I guess I should at least fake an apology.
lines.zh: 我想我至少该道个歉，哪怕是装的。

lines.en: : I’m really sorry for everything that happened.
lines.zh: : 对于发生的一切，我真的很抱歉。

lines.en: : I wish I could be more sincere but...amnesia.
lines.zh: : 我也希望自己能更真诚一点，不过……失忆了嘛。

lines.en: : Knock it off with the amnesia crap! I know damn well that’s not true!
lines.zh: : 少拿失忆这套鬼话糊弄我！我他妈清楚得很，那不是真的！

lines.en: : You’re just making up a convenient excuse to try and get back together with me because I’m famous now!
lines.zh: : 你只是找了个方便的借口想跟我复合，因为我现在出名了！

lines.en: : I expected this! I knew it was coming one day!
lines.zh: : 我早就料到了！我就知道会有这一天！

lines.en: : Which is precisely why Nee-chan hasn’t dated anyone else ever since you disappeared.
lines.zh: : 所以自从你消失之后，姐姐才一直没跟别人交往过。

lines.en: scene reunion35
: That’s...
lines.zh: : 那是因为……

lines.en: : That's just because I’ve been really busy, you know, doing idol stuff.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为我一直很忙，你知道的，做偶像那一套。

lines.en: : It’s not like I was just waiting around for closure or anything.
lines.zh: : 我又不是在等着一个了结什么的。

lines.en: : Okay, break time’s over!
lines.zh: : 好了，休息时间结束！

lines.en: : Niki, we need you back on set or none of us are getting paid for today.
lines.zh: : Niki，我们需要你回到布景上，不然今天谁都拿不到钱。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’m coming...
lines.zh: : 知道啦知道啦。我这就来……

lines.en: scene reunion36
Niki begins to walk away, but stops in her tracks before making it back onto set.
lines.zh: Niki 转身要走，可在回到布景上之前又停住了脚步。

lines.en: I can’t help but wonder if she put this costume on herself. That ribbon seems like it would be hell to tie behind your back.
lines.zh: 我忍不住想知道这身衣服是不是她自己穿上的。那个蝴蝶结要在背后系上，肯定麻烦得要命。

lines.en: : If you’re going to disappear again, at least take my phone number so I can know you’re not dead.
lines.zh: : 如果你又要消失，至少把我的电话号码存上，好让我知道你没死。

lines.en: : Noriko and I looked everywhere.
lines.zh: : Noriko 和我找遍了所有地方。

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize she was still looking, but...
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道她还在找，不过……

lines.en: : I’m...glad she found you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我……挺高兴她找到了你，我想。

lines.en: : Niki...please.
lines.zh: : Niki……拜托。

lines.en: : I’M FUCKING COMING!
lines.zh: : 我他妈这就来！

lines.en: Niki reaches into my pocket and snags my phone out of it, punching her contact info in.
lines.zh: Niki 把手伸进我的口袋，掏出我的手机，把自己的联系方式输了进去。

lines.en: $ nikinumber = True
Also, she apparently knows my passcode?
lines.zh: 另外，她居然知道我的解锁密码？

lines.en: I don’t even think Ami knows that.
lines.zh: 我都不确定 Ami 知不知道。

lines.en: : Is that...a girl with a dildo in her mouth as your wallpaper?...
lines.zh: : 那个……你壁纸是嘴里含着假阳具的女孩？……

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : You are absolutely fucking disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真是他妈的恶心至极。

lines.en: scene black
: Hiiii~ Sorry for my attitude earlier, everyone!
lines.zh: : 大家——好~ 刚才态度不好，实在抱歉！

lines.en: : It’s been really, really hard having to keep up with everything, but I promise I’ll do my very best to improve and live up to all of your expectations~
lines.zh: : 要跟上这一切真的非常非常辛苦，不过我保证会竭尽全力改进，不辜负大家的期待~

lines.en: : Okay! Niki Nakayama Coca-Cola Ad: Take 23!
lines.zh: : 好！Niki Nakayama 可口可乐广告：第 23 条！

lines.en: The director begins rattling off a bunch of TV related terms and I am suddenly even more lost than I have been throughout this entire afternoon.
lines.zh: 导演开始连珠炮似的蹦出一堆电视术语，我一下子比这整个下午都更摸不着头脑了。

lines.en: Noriko lightly punches me in the arm and reaffirms that she has no intention of losing to her sister, but-
lines.zh: Noriko 轻轻打了我胳膊一拳，重申她绝没有打算输给她姐姐，不过——

lines.en: At this point in time, I don’t even know if her sister is in the running anymore.
lines.zh: 到了这个节骨眼上，我甚至不知道她姐姐还算不算在竞争行列里。

lines.en: Yes, she did wait X amount of years without seeing anyone else, but-
lines.zh: 没错，她是等了那么些年，也没跟别人交往，不过——

lines.en: Maybe all she wanted really was closure.
lines.zh: 也许她真正想要的只是一个了结。

lines.en: I’ll have to call her soon and...see exactly where we stand.
lines.zh: 我得尽快给她打个电话，然后……看看我们到底处在什么位置。

lines.en: $ day271 = True
$ niki_love += 50
$ noriko_love += 1
Congratulations! You now have Niki’s phone number!
lines.zh: 恭喜！你获得了 Niki 的电话号码！

lines.en: Surprise! Niki’s affection is already [niki_love]!
lines.zh: 惊喜！Niki 对你的好感度已经是 [niki_love]！

lines.en: Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
lines.zh: Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]！

lines.en: Noriko and Kirin can now be found at the dorms and their respective hangout spots on the weekend!
lines.zh: 周末可以在宿舍以及各自的常驻地点找到 Noriko 和 Kirin！
